title: Electric furnace resistance
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the resistance of the electric furnace using R = E/I₁ - r.

title: Furnace power (S1 only)
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the heating power for the first case using P = I₁²R.

title: Circuit voltage (both closed)
description: Important: Correctly finds the terminal voltage when both switches are closed using U = E - I₂r.

title: Furnace current (both closed)
description: Important: Correctly calculates the current through the furnace in the parallel setup using I_N = U / R.

title: Furnace power (both closed)
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the heating power for the second case using P = U * I_N or I_N²R.

title: Electrolytic cell current
description: Important: Correctly finds the current through the electrolytic cell using I = I₂ - I_N.

title: Chemical power conversion
description: Important: Correctly calculates the power converted to chemical energy using P_chem = U*I - I²r_A.

title: Misapplied power formula
description: Pitfall: Penalize if student uses P = I²R for the furnace in part (2) without using the correct parallel-circuit current.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Penalize sign errors in voltage calculation or omission/incorrect use of units in final answers.

title: Energy conservation reasoning
description: Optional: Explicitly states that the difference between total electrical power and Joule heating in the cell is chemical power.
